screens.landing_and_login: index.html (#login opens the prototype login popup)
screens.fee_master: fee-master.html – Renewal Amounts & Settings (renewal fee + garbage fee per licence, renewal window, late surcharge)
screens.items_master: items-master.html – Items & sub-items master (Department Admin edits; other officers view)
screens.documents_master: documents-master.html – Document types master: who each document is asked of (every individual / company, renewal, change, form answers), format, and mapping to items / sub-items

storage: localStorage key tl_demo_state_v6 (Reset demo data restores the seed); uploaded files in IndexedDB tl_demo_files

new_and_change: Inspector (circle pool) – inspection report with fee assessment: licence/change fee + garbage fee
HOD (CCS / Issuing Authority) – fixes the assessed fee
renewal: Applicant uploads GST clearance certificate and pays renewal fee + garbage fee + late surcharge by BR, uploads BR with the renewal
Inspector checks BR, marks original BR received, forwards

sendBacks.BO → Applicant: resubmission goes to the same BO

workflow.renewalFine: Late surcharge: 30-day grace to 30 April; ₹5/day from 1 May counted to the first submission date; paid with the renewal; no cut-off
workflow.renewalWindow: Configurable by the Department Admin (fee-master.html): renewal opens 1–6 months before 31 March, default 2 months (1 February). Change request is blocked once renewal is due.
workflow.inspectionNotes: Visible to officers only, not to applicants
workflow.fees: No fee master. Inspector assesses the fee + garbage fee for each new licence; HOD fixes it. The licence keeps that first amount as its renewal amount; the Department Admin (ADM-01) can revise it per licence, each revision kept with old/new amounts, changed by/on.

documentRules: tl-flow.js docList() reads config.docTypes (document types master) and the documents mapped to the chosen item / sub-item (config.categories[].docs, items[].docs). Mandatory wins when a document is asked for more than one reason. Masters are edited by the Department Admin.
itemsMaster: config.categories: item (purpose) → optional sub-items (activity). Department Admin can add, rename (earlier names kept), deactivate / activate items and sub-items and choose the extra documents each calls for from the document types master. Changes kept in config.itemHistory and the audit log. Each item also switches on the form questions it needs (hotel details, franchise, educational institute); other items do not show them.
